messages.subject: Formatting issues with navbarPage
parts:
I was trying to do a simple example with navbarPage and I noticed that if one of my tabPanels has a sidebarPanel with a selectInput dropdown menu then the menu is cut off.

shinyUI(navbarPage("Application Title",
  tabPanel("Component 1",
    fluidPage(
      
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput('test', "choice",c("1","2","3","4))),
      
      mainPanel("Main")
      )
    ) 
))

Any way to fix this?

messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: Re: Formatting issues with navbarPage

Hi

Not sure why it happened. You might want to try sidebarLayout(). If you still want to use fluidPage, try using it along with fluidRow to adjust the layout.
Hope it will help.
